## D033 16-rel Regression Slope (2026-05-16) ⭐⭐

- MiniLM confound = **type frequency**（BCS↔freq r=0.201），控制后 partial r=0.133 (p=0.107, n.s.)
- Qwen3 confound = **degree centrality**（BCS↔degree r=0.854），控制后 partial r=0.063 (p=0.442, n.s.)

- 与 Few-NERD 对比：Few-NERD 无 centrality confound（BCS↔freq r=0.042）

- Count curve 单调退化：count_1 acc=0.858 → count_40 acc=0.588 (-27pp)

- **Channel 2 FewRel SUCCESS**: LLaMA Δ=-27.1pp(count_8)/-24.0pp(count_16)，达 Qwen3 -31.2pp 的 87%
  - Pearson r=-0.39 (p=0.004), Spearman ρ=-0.43 (p=0.001)
  - 无 floor effect：均值 accuracy=0.77，范围 0.41-0.98
  - **跨模型+跨任务+跨规模三重泛化验证完成**
